resources.string: This app allows you to launch J2ME apps and games on Android.

JL-Mod Plus is a fork of JL-Mod by woesss (Yury Kharchenko), itself a fork and experimental mod of J2ME-Loader by Nikita Shakarun. The fork is maintained through sustained design, engineering, testing, and infrastructure work. Upstream attribution and license notices are preserved in the project.
